avoidance_mode_api.description: Uses Stockfish to validate if user's move avoids the trap. Safe moves (Qe7, g6) return is_safe=true

recognition_mode_api.description: Validates user answer for trap recognition with scoring: perfect, good, partial, missed

recognition_mode_perfect_answer.description: Entering 'Yes' + 'Qxf7' shows 'Perfect!' result with explanation, key squares, and why it works

execution_mode_api.description: Returns trap data with setup_moves, user_moves, engine_moves for step-by-step learning
